title: The Last Toast
timeline: Victor encouraged Adrian to open the vintage red wine Victor had gifted a week earlier
Adrian refused red wine; Sarah poured him a glass of WHITE wine
Adrian carried WHITE wine into the library
Emma slipped into the kitchen and stirred poison sachets into Victor's red wine
Emma wrapped the bottle in a white table cloth and took it upstairs, then into the library
Emma convinced Adrian to finally taste Victor's gift
Adrian drank the poisoned red wine and died
Emma removed the original white-wine glass and left Victor's bottle beside the body to frame Victor
finalExplanation: Adrian never carried red wine into the library — Sarah poured him white wine. Emma slipped into the kitchen after Victor left, laced Victor's gift bottle with poison from the sachets, wrapped it in a white table cloth, and brought it to Adrian. The size 10 shoes on the CCTV weren't Victor's — they matched Emma. She staged the scene to frame Victor.
